subject: FisherCorp compliance packet sync & logistics
messages:
From: Paul Sommers <paul.sommers@fishercorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@fishercorp.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 + CAIQ packet request and kickoff call

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking the time — FisherCorp is starting a compliance intake for our vendor risk team and we need a consolidated packet from Redwood covering SOC 2 scope, CAIQ responses, and a handful of evidentiary samples (SSO screenshots, log samples, retention policy excerpt).

Can we schedule a 30-minute sync next week to go over the CAIQ scope and confirm owners for the artifacts? Ideally we'd get the packet by the end of next week (Fri 5/28) so our risk team can review ahead of procurement.

A few things we care about:
- Data residency and log retention windows
- Access control / SSO flow and admin lists
- Sample logs showing authentication events and admin activity

Proposed windows: Mon 5/24 or Tue 5/25 morning PT. Let me know what works.

Regards,
Paul
Paul Sommers
Senior Information Security Manager
FisherCorp
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Paul Sommers <paul.sommers@fishercorp.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 + CAIQ packet request and kickoff call

Hi Paul — thanks for the clear list. We can definitely get this in motion.

Available slots:
- Mon 5/24 09:00-09:30 PT
- Mon 5/24 11:00-11:30 PT
- Tue 5/25 09:30-10:00 PT

Suggested agenda (30m):
1) Confirm CAIQ sections in scope (10m)
2) Assign artifact owners & delivery dates (10m)
3) Logistics for evidence drop (Drive link / secure transfer) and next steps (10m)

Pre-call: I'll attach our current artifact roster and a CAIQ template so you can preview. Can you confirm which logging window you prefer (30/60/90 days) so we prepare samples accordingly?

Attachments: redwood_artifact_roster_v1.xlsx, redwood_caiq_template.pdf

If those slots work I’ll send a calendar invite and a Meet link.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 + CAIQ packet request and kickoff call

Marissa / Aditya —

Quick alignment on owners so we can commit to the 5/28 packet target:
- I’ll take ownership of CAIQ answers related to access management (SSO, provisioning, admin roles) and will prepare SSO screenshots and IdP config excerpts.
- Aditya, can you own log samples and the short retention policy excerpt? Preferably provide a 30‑day and 90‑day auth event sample (sanitized).
- Marissa, you can own the control matrix export and SOC 2 scoping doc (I’ll link to your folder).

Also we should prepare a brief README that maps each artifact to the CAIQ question(s) so FisherCorp’s reviewers can find evidence quickly — I can draft that after the call.

I’ll block Mon 5/24 09:00 PT pending confirmation.

Thanks,
Irene
Senior Trust & Compliance Analyst
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Paul Sommers <paul.sommers@fishercorp.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, procurement@fishercorp.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 + CAIQ packet request and kickoff call

Hi Paul — confirmed Mon 5/24 09:00-09:30 PT. Calendar invite sent (Google Meet). Meeting link: https://meet.google.com/rw-fisher-sync

Updated agenda and pre-call asks:
- Agenda (30m):
  1) Scope confirmation (SOC 2 in-scope services & data flows)
  2) CAIQ section owners and primary contacts (Irene -> Access; Aditya -> Logging/Retention; Marissa -> SOC 2 docs)
  3) Evidence delivery plan & deadlines (drive folder vs secure upload)

Pre-call asks (please provide before the meeting if possible):
- Preferred log window (30/90 days)
- Any non-standard compliance requirements (e.g., data residency constraints)

Action items we’ll take on:
- Marissa: Assemble control matrix export and SOC 2 scoping note (attach soc2-control-matrix.xlsx)
- Irene: Draft mapping README for CAIQ answers
- Aditya: Prepare two sanitized log samples and retention excerpt

Attachments: soc2-control-matrix.xlsx

We’ll create a shared Drive folder and provide upload instructions during the call. If you prefer a signed transfer (DocuSign/ShareFile), let us know — I included a preparatory DocuSign link in case procurement wants an NDA/consent form signed prior to evidence transfer.

See you Monday.

Regards,
Marissa
From: Paul Sommers <paul.sommers@fishercorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@fishercorp.com, security@fishercorp.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 + CAIQ packet request and kickoff call

Thanks — Mon 9:00 PT works. We’ll aim for 90-day log samples.

Procurement confirmed they prefer Drive upload to the shared folder with a single archive named: fisher_redwood_evidence_20270528.zip (we will coordinate upload credentials during the call).

Deliverables and tentative owners we agreed on:
- SSO screenshots, admin roster — Redwood (Irene)
- Log samples (sanitized 90d) — Redwood (Aditya)
- SOC 2 scoping and control matrix — Redwood (Marissa)

We’ll have a quick security intake review on Tue 5/25 afternoon if additional clarifications are needed; otherwise plan to ingest the packet on Fri 5/28.

Best,
Paul
